title: Remove extra blank lines in chat
brief: A chat transcript has too many empty lines between messages. Squeeze consecutive blank lines into just one.
text:
Alice: hi


Bob: hey


Alice: ready?

expect.text:
Alice: hi

Bob: hey

Alice: ready?

why: The global command finds empty lines and joins them up to the next non-empty line, collapsing runs of blanks efficiently.
author: claude (daily)
hint: Use :g to target empty lines and j to join.
